name: action.drive.name
editNote: The book prints the action as 'DRIVE (VARIES)': '(Varies)' stands where an action icon goes, so it is the cost, not part of the name (the rules say 'Driving' on page 212 and 'a 2-action or 3-action Drive' on page 215). The name is 'Drive' and the action is variable, with effects for 1 to 3 actions.
